timing_model.scope: po2 20 native CPU; segment/recursion scaling from ten measured 10M proofs; fixed identity and wrapping retained

frozen_stretch_forecast.scope: predicted from ten completed warm 10M proofs before the 46M proof completes

linux.build_flags: -Dwarnings -Adead_code (existing unused prover fields in execution-only subset)

refusal.error: host RAM is short for risc0:generic: needs ~25.2 GiB, 87.0 GiB already reserved by proofs in flight, 44.3 GiB available

intentional_cancellation.reason: Po2-18 sizing screen: segment proving alone took 403.655s. Preserve the completed first proof and screen po2 20 under the same 32-GiB guard before final five-proof acceptance. Remaining po2-18 slots intentionally cancelled, not discarded or retried.

limitations: Five measured warm proofs per fixed 10M fixture; one excluded first-process warmup each, not cold-boot timing.
One arithmetic stretch proof only; hashing stretch sized but not proved in this campaign.
Physical footprints are sampled, not an exact peak or a kernel-enforced memory cap.
Thermal nominal can mean unavailable; no energy or frequency measurements.
Deadline scaling is workload-dependent and does not establish marketplace feasibility.
Linux execution tests passed; Linux GPU proving runtime was not tested.
